raw_text: The Bulletin of the Atomic Scientists assesses the latest round of Russian nuclear rhetoric as dangerous but not indicative of imminent nuclear use. Our analysis shows the rhetoric cycle follows a predictable pattern tied to Western policy milestones. However, the normalization of nuclear threats in Russian public discourse remains deeply concerning and erodes the nuclear taboo that has held since 1945. The Doomsday Clock remains at 90 seconds to midnight.
